citation.short_title: Melvin-Koushki, The New Brethren of Purity (2025)

content: The New Brethren paper says Ibn Turka's first Timurid patron was Iskandar Sulṭān (r. 1409-14), that Ibn Turka first formulated his Pythagorean theory of lettrist sovereignty for him, and that Investigations and On the Letters were almost certainly commissioned by Iskandar.
